name: cutify-that-terminal
description: Make a macOS terminal cute and then prove it renders: 463 built-in Ghostty themes, rounded Nerd Fonts, and a Starship prompt — plus a verify-glyphs script that catches the "?" boxes before the user sees them, and a per-terminal prompt split so Ghostty keeps its icons while Apple Terminal, VS Code and ssh get a prompt that cannot break. macOS + Homebrew + zsh.
